experiment_data.hypothesis: On real hate speech data (UC Berkeley), LLM annotation of dehumanization level exhibits text-feature-based misclassification heterogeneity (e.g., by target group type, text length, presence of explicit language), and EC-HTE subgroup-stratified correction produces qualitatively different CATE distributions compared to global correction — demonstrating the practical relevance of the bias mechanism with text-feature subgroups consistent with the TweetEval experiment design
